title: Cosmology of fractional gravity
summary: This is a first study of the cosmology of classical fractional gravity, a nonlocal proposal endowed with self-adjoint fractional d'Alembertian operators which serves as the basis for an ultraviolet-complete theory of quantum gravity. We derive the classical covariant nonlocal equations of motion for an arbitrary fractional exponent $γ$ and reduce them to the Friedmann equations on a homogeneous and isotropic cosmological background.
